title: Aleksandar Vucic, the Serbian leader brought down by students

title: Vietnam develops next-generation Japanese encephalitis vaccine
desc: A next-generation Japanese encephalitis vaccine developed in Vietnam has demonstrated a strong immune response in clinical studies and is undergoing final preparations for market registration, according to research findings presented at a recent scientific conference.

title: One in three young adults turns to AI for substance use
desc: More than 32% of participants in a Rutgers study reported using ChatGPT and similar chatbots for substance-use information.

title: Antonelli wins US Grand Prix to close on world title
desc: Kimi Antonelli claimed his ninth win of the season, but not quite the drivers' title on Sunday when he drove his Mercedes to a convincing triumph ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc in an intriguing and strategic United States Grand Prix.

title: Namibia: Penehupifo Created Safe Space for Geingob to Reveal Cancer Diagnosis
desc: Former first lady Monica Geingos says Penehupifo Pohamba helped create a safe space for former president Hage Geingob to publicly disclose his prostate cancer diagnosis, encouraging men across Namibia to seek testing.

title: Namibia: Etosha Fires Contained As 16 Percent of Park Burns
desc: All threatening fires at Etosha National Park had been suppressed by 19h00 on Saturday, following a joint effort by ministry staff, members of the Namibian Defence Force, Ongava staff, surrounding conservancies and farms.
